mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_search_index (id, file_node_id, name, path, content, suffix, mime_type, size, tags, created_by, created_at, updated_at, revision, deleted) VALUES (#{index.id}, #{index.fileNodeId}, #{index.name}, #{index.path}, #{index.content}, #{index.suffix}, #{index.mimeType}, #{index.size}, #{index.tags}, #{index.createdBy}, COALESCE(#{index.createdAt}, NOW()), NOW(), 0, 0) ON CONFLICT (file_node_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, path = EXCLUDED.path, content = EXCLUDED.content, suffix = EXCLUDED.suffix, mime_type = EXCLUDED.mime_type, size = EXCLUDED.size, tags = EXCLUDED.tags, updated_at = NOW(), deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM nw_search_index WHERE file_node_id = #{fileNodeId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM nw_search_index WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC
